baseline_models.focus_anchor: ترجف الأرض والجبال ... وكانت الجبال كثيبا مهيلا
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse moves one repeated subject from high solid mass through violent shaking into a gathered but self-releasing granular state. Matter remains present, but the cohesion that made it load-bearing disappears.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day supplies a bounded occasion whose defining content is the material reversal that follows.
Violent shaking supplies the mechanical disturbance that breaks the terrain's stable organization.
The lower ground opposite the sky makes the supporting layer itself participate in the failure.
The repeated high solid mass supplies the maximally stable before-state and the same subject's transformed after-state.
Temporal predication presents the dune condition as an actualized state of the mountains.
A gathered heap or dune preserves mass locally while replacing monolithic structure with particles.
Loose measured stuff sent pouring makes the heap unstable and completes the shift from solid support to granular flow.

changed_reading.before: A generic earthquake in which mountains are compared with sand.
changed_reading.after: A phase transition in which the world's support and its hardest masses retain material but lose binding, stance, and load-bearing form.

baseline_models.mechanism: The opening time-word can denote a severe occurrence, while كانت realizes a new predicate. The day is therefore characterized not merely by when shaking happens but by the achieved conversion of the mountains.

activation_trace.role: An event-day or severe occasion turns the temporal heading into a name for a world-changing occurrence.
Being and temporal predication mark the loose dune as the event's realized state.
The gathered dune supplies the new nominal identity assigned within the event.
Its pouring instability makes the new state dynamic rather than a static visual resemblance.

changed_reading.before: Day is a calendar frame around a destructive scene.
changed_reading.after: Day names a severe occurrence whose identity consists in forcing apparently permanent forms into an actually new state.

baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of جبل supplies formed or innate constitution. Predicating a loose pouring heap of that repeated noun permits a focus-only reading in which catastrophe reaches not only shape but the confidence that created constitution is self-securing.

activation_trace.role: Innate formed nature supplies the deeper kind of stability that the repeated mountain subject appears to possess.
Being and predication carry the formed subject into a contrary realized condition.
The heap retains substance while reducing constituted form to aggregation.
Pouring loose matter prevents the aggregate from recovering the fixed constitution associated with the mountain.

changed_reading.before: Only the mountains' external geometry is destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The verse experimentally exposes formed nature itself as contingent: substance survives while identity-conferring cohesion does not.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explicitly gives weight to a word, whereas the focus makes the landscape's paradigms of weight and solidity pour like loose material. This creates a hierarchy in which durable gravity belongs to the received utterance rather than to matter.

activation_trace.role: Heaviness opposed to lightness gives the contextual word material gravity, providing the weight that the focus contrastively relocates.
The high solid mass is the obvious material bearer of weight whose reliability is revoked.
Pouring loose matter supplies the mountain's loss of durable, weight-bearing integrity.

structural_cues: In 73:5, heavy directly qualifies قول; in 73:14, the repeated mountains receive the contrary predicate of loose pourability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a heavy word and mountains becoming loose material; I supply the contrastive arrow that enduring weight migrates from geology to speech. A live alternative is that both images independently communicate enormity.

changed_reading.before: Mountains lose physical solidity in an isolated catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The scene also reverses intuitive weight: revelation remains weight-bearing while the world's heaviest landmarks become pourable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressed body moves from wrapping into upright standing and deliberate footing. The focus then removes stance from the earth's own upright masses, making commanded human posture a disciplined response that does not depend on permanently stable ground.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping in clothes supplies the enclosed resting posture from which the addressee is summoned.
Bodily rising and standing supplies the deliberate vertical posture contrasted with mountains that cannot remain standing.
A foot treading a place supplies intentional contact with ground and turns stability into a practiced relation.
The lower ground is the bodily support that now shakes rather than guarantees footing.
High solid masses act as the world's upright bodies before their posture fails.
The collapsing pour is the terminal loss of stance against which disciplined standing is read.

structural_cues: The opening imperative قم and 73:6's language of footing precede a focus verse in which the ground and its tallest forms fail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wrapping, standing, footing, shaking ground, and collapsing mountains; I infer a body-to-world contrast in which practiced stance survives conceptually when natural stance fails. The alternative is simple thematic succession without contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts terrain losing stability.
changed_reading.after: Terrain failure becomes the backdrop for a prior discipline of standing: stability is an enacted posture, not a property guaranteed by the world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly calibrates duration by small amount, half, subtraction, addition, determined measure, and exhaustive count. Against that field, the focus's gathered dune is immediately qualified by matter that pours without measure, so physical collapse becomes a collapse of calibratability.

activation_trace.role: Smallness supplies the first explicit quantitative limit in the contextual calibration sequence.
The half supplies a determinate fraction against which unbounded pouring can register as measure-loss.
Partial subtraction supplies controlled removal rather than uncontrolled disintegration.
Increase and growth complete the context's bidirectional adjustment of a measured whole.
A magnitude brought to its limit supplies divine determination of the night as the governing measurement frame.
Exhaustive counting supplies the human limit explicitly reached by the contextual measuring effort.
The gathered heap preserves a nominally bounded quantity just before its containment fails.
Loose matter poured without measuring turns granular motion into the failure of retained quantity and boundary.

structural_cues: The early little-half-decrease-increase sequence is resumed in 73:20 by divine measuring and the admission that humans cannot exhaustively count it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dense quantitative sequence and a focus branch whose loose matter is sent forth without measuring; I infer that material failure is also loss of calibratability. The alternative is that night regulation and mountain collapse remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The mountains merely change from rock into sand.
changed_reading.after: A carefully measured world crosses into an aggregate that still has mass but no longer retains countable boundary, proportion, or controlled adjustment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Contextual recitation gathers units and sets them in ordered succession. The focus likewise names a gathered mass, but its final qualifier makes those units pour apart. The catastrophe can therefore be read as material disarticulation set against verbal articulation.

activation_trace.role: Consistent ordering and arrangement supply the context's positive model for composing discrete elements.
Gathering and assembly supply the operation by which verbal units become a coherent recitation.
The solid mountain supplies the integrated whole whose material articulation is undone.
A gathered heap preserves the lexical image of assembly while changing the assembled units from rock to grains.
Pouring instability reverses ordered assembly into material disarticulation.

structural_cues: 73:4 intensifies ordered recitation with verb and verbal noun, while 73:14 closes its nominal transformation with an adjective of unstable flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering and ordering for recitation and gathering plus pouring for the dune; I map both onto relations among discrete units. The live alternative is that the verbal and granular domains share imagery without intended contrast.

changed_reading.before: The mountain is pulverized into loose grains.
changed_reading.after: The mountain is materially de-articulated, a negative counterpart to the context's work of gathering and ordering speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, bodies are constrained externally by fetters and internally by throat obstruction; in the focus, fixed terrain is released into flow. The event distributes mobility asymmetrically rather than producing undifferentiated chaos.

activation_trace.role: A restraining fetter supplies external blockage of bodily movement immediately before the terrain is unbound.
Obstruction in the throat supplies internal blockage of passage and sharpens the movement reversal.
The normally immobile solid mass supplies what unexpectedly receives mobility.
Loose material pouring down supplies the newly released movement of the landscape.

structural_cues: Fetters and choking food occupy 73:12-13 directly before the earth-and-mountains transformation in 73:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked bodies followed by flowing mountains; I infer a selective inversion in which movement is transferred from agents to terrain. An alternative is that the adjacency only accumulates independent punishments.

changed_reading.after: Mobility is reassigned: the landscape is unbound into flow precisely as embodied agents are bound and their passages obstructed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus destabilizes the lower ground and its raised masses; the following context opens the upper canopy by splitting. Together they form a three-level spatial mechanism in which support below, mediating peaks, and enclosure above all cease to hold.

activation_trace.role: The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the upper enclosing boundary paired with the focus's lower ground.
Opening and splitting supply failure of the upper boundary, complementing granular failure below.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the support boundary that begins the enclosure failure.
Raised solid masses occupy the middle vertical register and lose their bridging stability.
Downward granular flow makes the middle register collapse as the upper register splits.

structural_cues: The focus names earth and mountains; 73:18 resumes the same event with the singular sky split by it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lower ground, raised mountains, an upper canopy, shaking, pouring, and splitting; I assemble them into one vertical enclosure system. The alternative is a list of separate cosmic effects without systemic direction.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a local terrestrial earthquake.
changed_reading.after: It is the lower phase of a total enclosure failure: support shakes, intermediate solids flow downward, and the covering above opens.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next occurrence of day is grammatically assigned a state-making action that turns children gray. That causative pattern activates the focus's day plus predicated mountain-state as one cross-scale transforming event, acting on bodies and geology alike.

activation_trace.role: The repeated severe event-day identifies the same kind of occasion as an active transformer rather than a neutral date.
Making a thing enter a state supplies the explicit causative operator for the contextual day's effect.
Gray hair and aging supply the body's abruptly achieved after-state.
The focus's severe event-day anchors the same transforming occasion at geological scale.
Actualized predication supplies the mountains' achieved after-state parallel to the children's grayness.
The dune is the geological state produced across the event's scale shift.
Pouring instability makes geological transformation as abrupt and irreversible as the bodily aging image.

structural_cues: 73:17 gives يوم a relative clause with causative يجعل, while 73:14 pairs يوم with a realized predicate introduced by كانت.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated day language and parallel state changes in children and mountains; I infer one event-operator acting across biological and geological scales. A live alternative treats day as circumstance in 73:14 but grammatical cause only in 73:17.

changed_reading.before: The day contains separate frightening effects.
changed_reading.after: The day functions as a cross-scale state transformer, aging bodies and weathering the world's most durable forms in one operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context establishes east-west coordinates and later a path toward the Lord. The focus removes the reliability of earth and mountain landmarks, so orientation shifts from stable topography to a relationally chosen route.

activation_trace.role: Light rising from the east supplies one fixed horizon coordinate in the contextual orientation system.
Sunset and the west supply the opposite coordinate, completing the horizon's spatial merism.
An extended traversable path supplies an orientation that can be taken toward a relation rather than read from terrain.
The lower ground supplies the ordinary plane on which physical routes and coordinates depend.
The high solid landmark supplies the most visible topographical guide whose permanence is revoked.
Pouring instability erases the fixed form needed for landmark-based wayfinding.

structural_cues: 73:9 spans east and west under one Lord; 73:19 says to take a path toward that Lord after the terrain-collapse scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies horizon coordinates, a traversable path, and dissolving landmarks; I infer a transfer from topographical to relational orientation. The alternative is that lordship, catastrophe, and path language are adjacent but not a wayfinding mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Mountain collapse communicates only loss of physical security.
changed_reading.after: It also strips away landmark-based orientation, leaving the context's path toward the Lord as a route not secured by enduring geography.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rumor branch of رجف and the chiefs branch of جبل inside an overtly geological sentence. It remains valid as a secondary social analogy because both branches are packet-backed focus roots and the context supplies circulating speech, denial, and informed witness. Downstream prose should label it exploratory and must not replace the literal cosmic scene with a claim that the nouns simply mean political actors.

activation_trace.role: Speech spreading among people supplies the social medium through which report-driven agitation can propagate.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the contested information that can destabilize a public order.
Testifying by knowledge supplies the counter-mode of accountable speech against circulating falsehood.
Agitating rumor gives the focus verb a packet-backed social disturbance image alongside violent shaking.
Chiefs likened to mountains supply the elevated social solids that agitation can reduce to an incoherent mass.
The gathered heap supplies a crowd-like remainder after hierarchical coherence fails.
Pouring instability supplies loss of cohesion in the social analogy without canceling the literal sand image.

changed_reading.before: Only geological masses are destabilized by physical shaking.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory overlay, circulating falsehood can agitate mountain-like authorities until hierarchy survives only as a loose, shifting aggregate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a gray-hair root into its packet branch of snow or frost whiteness on mountains and earth, then reads pulverization as accelerated aging or weathering. It remains anchored because that branch explicitly names both focus landforms and the focus predicates their rapid material decay. Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain aging analogy, not as a color claim about the dune.

activation_trace.role: Snow or frost whiteness on mountains and earth extends the contextual grayness image from bodies to the exact focus landforms.
The earth supplies one of the landforms explicitly named by the contextual whiteness branch.
The high solid mountain supplies the durable body subjected to event-speed weathering.
The gathered dune supplies the weathered residue of the formerly coherent landform.
Loose pouring matter supplies the terminal erosion state reached with impossible speed.

changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the event compresses geological aging into an instant: children gray and enduring landforms weather into loose residue.

strongest_changes: The sand image became a true cohesion and phase transition rather than a loose comparison.
The surrounding calibration language made unmeasured granular flow a collapse of count, proportion, and boundary.
Fetters and choking before the focus exposed a selective reversal in which bodies are blocked while terrain is released to move.
The split sky extended terrestrial failure into a lower-middle-upper enclosure collapse.
The repeated day that makes children gray turned the focus event into a cross-scale state transformer.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations were not broad end-time themes but reversals of material function: heavy speech versus lightened mountains, ordered and measured practice versus unmeasured flow, constrained bodies versus mobile terrain, and relational wayfinding after landmarks fail.
remaining_uncertainties: The weight-transfer, posture, articulation, and wayfinding models depend on reader-supplied contrasts rather than explicit causal syntax.
Day is grammatically causative in 73:17 but may remain only temporal in 73:14.
The rumor-chief and accelerated-aging readings are packet-backed but intentionally branch-distant analogies.
